scope: Two facade source changes only: borrowed root wire serialization and graph-domain comments. Old completed own-source challenges/metrics retain their exact inputs; current concrete composition is new evidence, not a rerun of each old mutant.
current_preservation_argument: GraphIncidence.incidence is target indicator minus source indicator; admitted unequal endpoints make d0 sets equivalent. distinct_edge_pairs and successful enumerated map imply distinct columns. triangle_at_ab/bc/ac and row_action identify signs; triangle_cancellation proves product zero. Core additionally checks concrete zero product.

RankCertificate.valid_rank identifies exact ranks through independently checked split identities. TwoStepComplex gives zero composition/image as cycles. CarrierDimensions proves quotient dimension and natural subtraction bounds. Facades add no mutable state or rank cache.

ScalarAdmission and reviewed BigRational establish admitted canonical Q. Raw hashing remains separate. TryFrom re-admits after hashes. Serde data/name preservation is source-reviewed and independently observed, not Rust/MIR extracted.

Graph table work O(E log E+T log E), input scans O(E+T). Dense initialization O(E*N+T*E) Q cells plus law multiplication and exact rank/certificate work. BigInt bit costs/matrix limits inherited; no unit-time or resource-totality claim.

Borrowed serialization removes full Carrier clone and subsequent matrix/weight clones. Field traversal and hash scans remain linear in coefficient bytes plus rational normalization costs. Source trace, not allocation/throughput measurement.

All explicit functions enumerated. Serde derives emit field visitors/struct sequences with error propagation; schema, independent owned-wire oracle and Probe cover names/order/data. Standard Clone/Eq/Debug are field traversal contracts, not admission bypasses.
